premise_correction.inherited: docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md called unit+10D4h the unit's external force list, drained by 0074F2E0, and the channel for engine thrust, damage and flooding.
premise_correction.found: unit+10D4h is a leak (flooding) model. 0074F930 accumulates water per leak point and 0074F2E0 turns those weights into a heeling torque. It has no push routine, no lifetime field and no one-shot flag, and no command ever passes through it.
evidence: 00818404 in the _ship diagnostic dump 00818340 emits the label "leakManager" for this sub-object and hands it to 0074EF20
segment 41 keyword set includes sumleaks and sumforces
0074F930 walks float rates[+18h], float water[+1Ch] and float3 points[+20h] with count at +14h and writes the totals at +28h and +2Ch
0074F2E0 writes only x and z of its output, leaving y zero, which is a heel/pitch torque and not a force
premise_correction.consequence: The force-command contract this packet was given does not exist in the binary. Commanded thrust is a direct rewrite of the rigid body's linear velocity, and steering is half a velocity rewrite and half a torque.

force_application_sites.note: AddForce has exactly one caller in the whole image; no command path reaches it.

uncertainties: Nothing writes unit+980h or unit+984h in any encoding a displacement scan can see. Every movss, fstp, mov and lea form against [reg+980h] and [reg+984h] was scanned across the whole image; the only stores are mov [esi+980h], ebx and mov [esi+984h], ebx at 004DA32B in an unrelated scene loader, and every ship-side access is a load. The producers must use a shifted base register, as 00825F20 itself does when it reads them as [EDI+670h] with EDI = unit+310h. The player and AI producers are NOT identified and the packet's central question is open.

unit+9A0h/+9A4h are read by the ship AI at 0099D5A4 and 0099D694: when either is non-zero it is clamped and used in place of the AI's own plan (0099D679, 0099D6B7, each with a validity byte). Their writers were not found. The plane classes have a control pair at the same offsets written by luaMW_PlaneSetRollCtrl (0089DE45) and luaMW_PlaneSetPowerCtrl (0089DFE5); no ship equivalent exists in the Lua API.

unit+102Ch, +1030h, +1034h and +1038h are zeroed together by the ship constructor at 0081F2EC..0081F304 and read by 00825DE0, 00825EC0, 009D4E30, 009DE5B0 and 009F3F80. No writer was found, by the same shifted-base problem, so the propeller load's producer remains open as docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md recorded.
